name: CSN 1310 减跑道 地面延误加油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 310, performing a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 221, you have received information Bravo, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 310，执行北京至广州航班，停在 221 号登机口，已收到通播 Bravo，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN1310, gate 221, information B, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN1310，221 号登机口，通播 B，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 310, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK 03 departure, departure runway 36 right, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，北京放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK 03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, BOBAK 03 departure, departure runway 36R, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 9500 meters, squawk 2536, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，BOBAK 03 离场，离场跑道 36R，起始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 9500 米，应答机 2536，CSN1310。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, expect slot time 0215 due to temporary departure restrictions, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，因临时离场限制，预计时隙 0215，准备好推出和开车时报告。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, slot time restriction has canceled, monitored Beijing Ground 121.975.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，时隙限制已取消，守听北京地面 121.975。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, request push back.

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, Beijing Ground, push back approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，北京地面，同意推出，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, CSN1310.

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back, you are on taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, taxiway Z4, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN1310，滑行道 Z4，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, your slot time has expired, your new slot time is 0325, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，你的时隙已过期，新时隙是 0325，自行决定开车。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0325, start up at own discretion, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0325，自行决定开车，CSN1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed startup and before taxiing checklist, you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成开车和滑行前检查单，准备好滑行，联系北京地面获取滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 310, taxi to holding point runway 36 right via taxiway Zulu 4, Zulu 3, Tango 5, Delta 6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Zulu 3、Tango 5、Delta 6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway Z4, Z3, T5, D6, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、Z3、T5、D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN1310。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, hold short of Tango 5, give way to Boeing 747 passing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，Tango 5 外等待，避让从左至右经过的 Boeing 747。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T5, traffic in sight, CSN1310.

cards.audioText: B: Now the traffic is clear, you decide to make intersection departure from Whiskey 2, contact Beijing Ground to request intersection departure from Whiskey 2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在飞机已脱离，你决定从 Whiskey 2 交叉口离场，联系北京地面请求从 Whiskey 2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN1310, clear of traffic, request intersection departure from W2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN1310，飞机已脱离，请求从 W2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, negative intersection departure due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point runway 36 right via taxiway Tango 5 and Delta 6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，因排序不能同意交叉口离场，继续经滑行道 Tango 5 和 Delta 6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point runway 36R via taxiway T5 and D6, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 T5 和 D6 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN1310。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36 right, you are ready for takeoff, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好起飞，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN1310, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN1310，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 310, hold short of runway 36 right, expect 15 minutes delay due thunderstorms in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，跑道 36R 外等待，因机场附近雷暴预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold short of runway 36R, CSN1310.

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 310, runway 36 right, line up and cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 310，跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, line up and cleared for takeoff, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，进跑道并可以起飞，CSN1310。

cards.audioText: B: You find you have no enough fuel to the destination due to long ground delay, tell Beijing Tower you have to taxi back to refuel your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B：由于长时间地面延误，你发现燃油不足以到达目的地，告诉北京塔台你必须滑回给飞机加油。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN1310, we have no enough fuel to the destination due long ground delay, request taxi back to refuel the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN1310，由于长时间地面延误，我们没有足够燃油到达目的地，请求滑回给飞机加油。
